title: Infinidye
description: Phenom-7280 "Infinidye" is a para-object that, when applied to a surface, manipulates the object's perceived color.
body:
# ⚠️ Warning

This mod is an early work in progress! Most of its features are either not implemented or are not documented. It is currently suitable for demo in [Mod Garden: DIY](https://modgarden.net/events/mod-garden/diy). Recipes are not yet implemented, so it must be given via commands with the `dyed_color` component.

# Phenom-7280 — Infinidye

[![Mod Garden: DIY](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ModGardenEvent/art/0c0f5b5e0d21f53ad4f4667a73db4d8802944e1f/badge/svg/diy/cozy.svg)](https://modgarden.net/events/mod-garden/diy)

**Special Mitigation of Phenomena**: Phenom-7280 is to be kept in secure locker G-43 at Site-92. All SMP Organization personnel are to avoid direct contact with Phenom-7280 and are to wear rubber gloves, protective eyeware, and standard lab coats. If the object comes in contact with eyes or skin, rinse with cold water for 5 minutes. Do not use soap. Report any incidents to Researcher Lovelock.

**Description**: Phenom-7280 "Infinidye" is a para-object that, when applied to a surface, manipulates the object's perceived color.
